rows.note: Use 裝置 as the all-purpose technical noun for a purpose-built device or piece of hardware.

example.english: This device can automatically regulate the room temperature.
example.traditional: 呢個裝置可以自動調節室內溫度。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zong1 zi3 ho2 ji5 zi6 dung6 tiu4 zit3 sat1 noi6 wan1 dou6

rows.note: Use 機 for an everyday mechanical or electrical machine when the exact technical term is unimportant.

example.english: The device suddenly won't turn on.
example.jyutping: bou6 gei1 dat6 jin4 m4 zoek6 laa3

rows.note: Use 周邊設備 specifically for computer peripherals and related hardware rather than a whole machine.

example.english: This peripheral device setup includes a keyboard, mouse, and printer.
example.traditional: 呢套周邊設備包括鍵盤、滑鼠同打印機。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 zau1 bin1 cit3 bei6 baau1 kut3 gin6 pun4 waat6 syu2 tung4 daa2 jan3 gei1
